claim_strengths.definition: Supported assertion explicitly limited by scope or conditions.
Direct assertion supported by relevant empirical evidence.
Cause-effect assertion requiring a credible causal design.

evidence_requirements.definition: Organizational or definitional wording; no empirical support is implied.
Background, theory, or a bounded source context.
A reported association, comparison, estimate, or observed pattern.
Evidence directly tests the stated proposition under the study design.
Multiple independent lines of relevant evidence agree.

rhetorical_functions.definition: State or locate the paper's own defensible position.
rhetorical_functions.label: Position a claim

rhetorical_functions.definition: Set confidence, scope, or conditions on an assertion.
rhetorical_functions.label: Qualify a claim

rhetorical_functions.definition: Present a source, observation, result, or estimate.
rhetorical_functions.label: Introduce evidence

rhetorical_functions.definition: Explain what evidence supports without exceeding it.
rhetorical_functions.label: Interpret evidence

rhetorical_functions.definition: Make a relevant similarity between results or sources explicit.
rhetorical_functions.label: Compare findings

rhetorical_functions.definition: Make a relevant difference between results or sources explicit.
rhetorical_functions.label: Contrast findings

rhetorical_functions.definition: Integrate multiple sources into a higher-level account.
rhetorical_functions.label: Synthesize sources

rhetorical_functions.definition: Specify an unresolved question or bounded absence.
rhetorical_functions.label: Identify a gap

rhetorical_functions.definition: Describe a constraint and its consequence for inference.
rhetorical_functions.label: State a limitation

rhetorical_functions.definition: Propose research or practice proportionate to evidence.
rhetorical_functions.label: Recommend action

rhetorical_functions.definition: Attribute an outcome to a cause under a credible design.
rhetorical_functions.label: Make a causal claim

rhetorical_functions.definition: Set population, context, time, concept, or analytic boundary.
rhetorical_functions.label: Define scope

risk_levels.definition: Wording unlikely to overstate evidence when slots are filled accurately.
Wording requires explicit attention to scope or evidence quality.
Causal, prescriptive, or otherwise consequential wording requiring strong checks.
